children.value:
ataḥ sādhanacatuṣṭayasaṃpannāya brahmajijñāsave mahyaṃn brahmopadiśetyāha -
yaditi

pradīptaśirasa iva jalarāśiṃ vivikṣostrividhatāpasaṃtaptasya mama
vilambasahanāśakteriti bhāvaḥ

durantā
turucchedā īhāḥ karmāṇi yasya tam

nanu vidyādharāḥ sarvavidyāśrayatvādvidyābalādeva sarvaduḥkhanirāsasamarthā
maṇimantrarasāyanādisiddhibhiraṇimādyairśvaryaiśca yuktāḥ śrūyante tatkimevaṃ
śrīmati tvayi kāmādiduḥkhaśātanāḥ kātaratākārpaṇyādidoṣāśca nipatitāḥ

yena
devayoniśreṣṭhatvānmānyatamo'pi tvaṃ nikṛṣṭakākayonimapi māṃ śaraṇāgato'si
pṛcchasi ca tatrāha - śrīmatyapīti

paṅkajapakṣe śrīmati lakṣmyādhāre guṇavati visatantumati
svāśrayasasnehajalavimukhatvāttatkaṇairalepyatvāccogrāṇi snehaniṣṭhurāṇi patrāṇi
yasya tādṛśe'pi

bhāvaiḥ śabdādiviṣayaistaistaiḥ sahasraśaḥ pūrvabhuktaireva tucchatamasukhalavārthaṃ
ya ālambho viṣayendriyasparśastallakṣaṇairviḍambanairvañcanopāyairvipralambhāḥ

aviśrāntamānasaṃ yathā syāttathā bhogabhaṅgeṣu bhaṅgureṣu bhogeṣu bhramato
mamāsya saṃsārādhvano'nto nāsti sthairyeṇāvasthānaṃ sthairyāvasthā ca nāsti

nanu bahutarapuṇyārjitayā vidyādharasaṃpadaiva tava kuto na viśrāntistatrāha -
māneti

mānaḥ svotkarṣāpādanābhimānaḥ apamānaḥ parāpakarṣāpādanam tadeva
paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yasyām
duṣṭaḥ ahaṃkāro yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ kāntayā ramyayā

ata eva
vāmayā vivekināṃ pratikūlayā striyā ca
sarvatra bhuktabhogatayā vairasyaṃ prakaṭayati - dṛṣṭā ityādinā

kīdṛśena vivekena kiṃ kiṃ kathaṃ kathaṃ jñātaṃ tatprathamaṃ cakṣurādiṣu
darśayati - rūpetyādinā

vanitāpiṇḍe idaṃ vastrābharaṇānulepanādikameva guṇāvahaṃ śobhākalpakam idaṃ
raktamāṃsāsthikeśādi na iti vikalpanaṃ vivecanaṃ muktvā vinā dhāvati cakṣuriti śeṣaḥ

tadviṣayāsaṅgadūṣitaṃ rāgāndhaṃ cetaḥ pradīparūparāgāndhapataṅgavat parasmai
utkṛṣṭāya maraṇādyanarthāya yāni īhitāni durvyasanāni tadunmukhaṃ sat
nānāvidhānāṃ bandhānāṃ vadhabandhanarakādyāpadāṃ vaśaṃ yāvadāyāti
tāvadviratimuparamaṃ nāyātītyarthaḥ

yathā kaścidatidoṣeṇa vairiṇā balādvaśīkṛto durgandhodakavahe nagarapraṇāle sadā
saṃcareti niyojito bhavati tadvadahamapi śleṣmādidurgandhodakapraṇāle nāsābile niyojita
ityarthaḥ

tarhi kiṃ tava rūpādayaḥ śabdāntā viṣayā durlabhā yena tadarthamanarthaḥ prāpto
netyāha - praṇatā ityādinā

vadhūmukhāni oṣadhyaścandanośīrāgarvādayaḥ puṣpāṇi samālambhanaṃ
karpūrakastūrīpauṣkalakādīnāṃ melanaṃ tadbhūmayastatprabhavāḥ

bhūyobhūyaḥ sevyamānaṃ saṃśuṣkaṃ kāṣṭhamiva virasaṃ saṃpannaṃ tatra
vāntāśanaprāye jāte kiṃ bhajāmi
vairasyenaiva tajjihāsā na tu tṛptyetyāha - bhuktveti

yeṣāṃ hiraṇyakaśipuprabhṛtīnāṃ vināśanaṃ vināśasādhanaṃ nāsīt
prāgjagatyaprasiddham

na śuṣkeṇa na cārdreṇa ityādivaraprārthane
sarvaprasiddhavadhasādhanapratiṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ
itthaṃ sati kiṃ kāryaṃ tadāha - prāpteneti

cirabhuktamahābhogānāmapi puṃsāṃ bhogakāle apagate abhuktabhogebhyaḥ
puruṣāntarebhyo na kaścidviśeṣo dṛśyata ityāha - yeneti

yena yena ciraṃ kāntā
ramyatarā bhogāściraṃ bhuktāstādṛśasya puṃso madhye kasyacidapi mūrdhniṃ
saṃjātaḥ kalpataruḥ kaiścidapi jantubhirna dṛṣṭo yena sa tacchāyāyāṃ sadaiva
pūrṇakāmo viśrāmyet

nāpi tasya gude vyomaplavo vimānādiḥ saṃjāto dṛṣṭo yena sa
sadaiva sarvatra viharedityarthaḥ

śabdādiviṣayātmakānāṃ bhūtānāmeva manaso bahirākarṣaṇena svasvabhogāya
śrotrādīndriyabhāvenāvasthānādindriyanāmānaḥ svaviṣayārayo mayā adya parijñātā
ityanvayaḥ

yena dṛṣṭā na dagdhāśca te tathāvidhāḥ puruṣāḥ
sarvajagatyapi dvitrā eva saṃbhāvyanta iti śeṣaḥ

itaḥ prabhṛti tulyairviśeṣaṇaiḥ palvalādisāmyenendriyāṇi varṇayati -
paṅkavantītyādinā

he āpannoddharaṇaśīla evaṃ varṇitaprakārendriyaprayuktāpatsāgaranimagnamakiṃcanaṃ
tyaktasarvasvamimaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ māṃ dayodayena kṛpotthena tattvopadeśenoddhara
yataḥ kāraṇājjagati ye ye prasiddhāstvādṛśāḥ kecana santastattvajñā dayālavo jayanti
sarvotkarṣeṇa vartante teṣāṃ saṃgamaṃ śaraṇāgatiṃ paramaśokaharaṃ vadanti
sarvaśāstrāṇi sarvajanāścetyarthaḥ
